openings.claim: Select adjudications by remaining acceptance uncertainty rather than fixed record-ID order. Bound each unresolved flagged paired candidate-minus-baseline correctness contribution by [-1,1], exactly zero for agreeing predictions; sum overall and per slice. Choose reachable rows whose possible contribution changes cross acceptance boundaries, prioritizing the slice nearest failure, then total, then record ID; recompute after every reveal. This interval ledger supports advance, reject or unresolved without confirming provisional gains.
openings.discriminator: Compared with identical bounds and fixed record-ID selection, prioritization should resolve more decisions within sixteen adjudications when reachable influential flags cluster near a binding threshold. The disagreement-heavy improvement slice may lose apparent certainty. No advantage is predicted for invariant contributions or when all influential rows are unavailable. Defeat includes no ordering benefit, a key-disproved supported decision, or insufficient reachable influential labels.
openings.probe: Use supplied records/labels only. Run both orders on matched copies with independently reset sixteen-adjudication allowances and seventy-minute caps. Preselect the same four withheld rows; log unsuccessful access without charging allowance. Advance iff total lower bound >=4 and every slice lower bound >=-2; reject iff total upper bound <4 or any slice upper bound <-2; otherwise unresolved. Freeze both reports before opening the sealed full-label decision key. Compare key-conforming decisions, unresolved frequency, adjudications and elapsed time, retaining selection reasons, affected slices and adjudication/time accounting.
openings.uncertainty: Unflagged supplied labels are fixed review inputs; if disputed, widen bounds or report unresolved. Selection uses only supplied predictions, slices and flags; annotator disagreement is not an invented record field. Sixteen rows may leave irreducible uncertainty; performance is unmeasured.

lineage.reason: Preserves the causal ordering change, complete rival prediction, boundary decision rules, resource/stopping caveats, declared preserves fit and uncertainties; no protected item omitted.

decision: Retain one bounded probe. Interval computation is available in the supplied environment; an informative ordering comparison depends on actual influential rows. No deployment readiness or closing-feedback loop is claimed.
